comparison: Perfect agreement on hiPSC resource generation and characterization (C3, C19-C36, C91, C97, C173, C175, C178, C184). Both evaluations find this SUPPORTED as a valuable community resource with comprehensive validation.
Perfect agreement on neural differentiation protocol and NPC characterization (C37-C45). Both evaluations find this SUPPORTED; peer reviewers implicitly accept by not challenging the methods.

Strong agreement on plasmid integration findings (C46-C58, C160-C172). Both find this SUPPORTED as an important cautionary tale. Peer reviewers request clarification about episomal methods but do not challenge the core findings.
Perfect agreement on additional CNVs analysis (C73-C76). Both find this SUPPORTED; peer reviewers accept that additional CNVs don't confound main findings.

Agreement on GSEA results (C79-C82, C139-C142) but with methodological concerns. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to clone vs. donor statistical issues requiring reanalysis.
Agreement on methodological recommendations about integration (C158-C159). Both find this SUPPORTED; peer reviewers explicitly request discussion of implications for Sendai virus methods.

Disagreement on differential expression analysis (C60-C66, C101-C103, C105, C108, C185-C186). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, raising significant concerns about treating clones as independent samples and requesting linear mixed models.
Agreement on sample limitation (C59, C101). Both acknowledge that duplication clones were excluded; peer reviewers request title change to reflect focus on microdeletion only.
Disagreement on gene ontology enrichment (C67-C70, C114-C118). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting external validation against GWAS loci and existing datasets.

Disagreement on MAPK3 findings and functional implications (C110-C113, C121-C124). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting lack of observable phenotype and requesting more conservative conclusions.

Agreement on uncertainty of clinical trait correlations (C83-C87, C143-C146, C148-C153). Both rate UNCERTAIN; OpenEval notes speculative interpretations while peer reviewers request more conservative framing given limited phenotypic data.

Partial overlap on WGCNA analysis (C77-C78, C132-C133). OpenEval finds trait-associated modules SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting reanalysis with proper donor-level statistical models and variance partitioning.

Overlap on WGCNA module interpretation (C137-C138, C154-C157). OpenEval finds patient-specific effects SUPPORTED but speculative; peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN and request polygenic risk score analysis to contextualize variable presentations.
Partial overlap on WGCNA clinical correlations (C83-C85). Both note methodological concerns; peer reviewers emphasize need for proper statistical accounting of donor vs. clone effects.

Disagreement on linking early changes to later phenotypes (C120-C124). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN noting speculation; peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN and explicitly request more conservative conclusions given no observable phenotype.
Overlap on functional predictions (C120). Both rate UNCERTAIN; peer reviewers note lack of phenotypic data undermines strong functional claims.

Disagreement on main conclusions (C5-C6, C174, C189). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED with caveats about temporal inference; peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting tone down of conclusions and noting no observable phenotype was presented.
Agreement on uncertainty of phenotypic heterogeneity model (C131, C147). Both rate UNCERTAIN; peer reviewers request polygenic risk score context for variable clinical presentations.
OpenEval finds background literature claims (C1-C2, C7-C18, C88-C90, C92) SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation; these are contextual citations not directly evaluated by reviewers.
OpenEval finds rationale and resource utility claims (C93-C96, C98-C99, C179) SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation; reviewers focus on empirical findings rather than rationale.
OpenEval finds study objectives and expression interpretation (C100, C104, C106-C107, C109) SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation of these framing claims.

OpenEval rates functional predictions from gene ontology (C125-C130) as UNCERTAIN, noting need for experimental validation especially for miRNA findings. No corresponding peer review evaluation of these specific predictions.
OpenEval finds literature summary and gap identification (C180-C183) SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation; these are background claims establishing novelty.
